why:
I checked both must_not items against the verifier brief.

Item 1: there are exactly two checks. Check 1 covers the stdin TSV-vs-CSV comparison and Check 2 covers the README. npm test, default CSV output and test coverage sit under "Advisory (not part of PASS or FAIL)", so they do not count as a third check. The single-row comparison is part of Check 1 and still tests the same expect line.

Item 2: Check 1 passes when both commands exit 0, cmp prints SAME and the output is the expected JSON array. Check 2 passes when grep finds a line that explains the flag. Neither PASS nor FAIL condition requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass.

The builder brief tells the builder to run npm test, but that is a build step, not a verifier check or PASS condition. The output does none of the must_not items.
